ntp.import.title: Coming from Edge?
ntp.import.text: Bring your bookmarks and browsing history to NeuralWeb in one go.
ntp.tiles.empty: The sites you visit most will show up here.
hist.clear.confirm: All of your browsing history will be deleted. This can't be undone.
imp.title: Import from Edge
imp.lead: Copies your bookmarks, browsing history and saved passwords from Microsoft Edge to NeuralWeb. Your data in Edge stays as it is; in NeuralWeb the passwords are kept encrypted with your Windows account.
imp.hint: Tip: while Edge is open its history file may be locked. Close Edge completely before importing.
imp.nothing: You didn't choose anything to import.

imp.note.kept.other: NeuralWeb's password was kept for {n} accounts

set.lang.text: Applies to every Neural app; each one opens in the chosen language the next time it starts.
set.theme-sync.text: When the theme changes in one Neural app, the others switch to it too.
set.show-bar.text: The sites you use often, under the address bar. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+B
set.shield.on.text: The shield stops ads, tracking scripts and known malicious addresses before the page even loads, and hides ad boxes.
set.shield.allow: Sites where the shield is off

set.shield.allow.removed: The shield is on again for {host}.

set.startup.restore.text: When NeuralWeb opens, the windows and tabs you last closed come back.
set.startup.newtab.text: Start with a clean page every time.
set.search.text: What you type in the address bar and on the new tab page is searched on Google; suggestions come from Google too.
set.dl.ask: Ask where to save each file
set.dl.ask.text: When off, files go straight to the folder above.
set.clear.history.text: The list of pages you visited.
set.clear.cookies.text: Signs you out of most sites.
set.clear.cache.text: Sites may open a little slower on your next visit.
set.clear.downloads.text: Only the list is deleted; the files stay where they are.
set.clear.nothing: You didn't choose anything to clear.
set.clear.confirm: The data you chose will be deleted from the NeuralWeb profile on this computer. This can't be undone.
set.perms.empty: You haven't allowed or blocked any site yet. When a site asks for the camera, your location or notifications, your answers are listed here.
set.perms.removed: Permission removed; the site will ask again next time.
set.default.text: If you want links and .html files to open in NeuralWeb, make NeuralWeb the default browser in Windows Settings. On the page that opens, press the {button} button at the top.
set.about.text: The browser of the Neural series. Pages are drawn by the Chromium engine; the browser's security depends on keeping this engine up to date.
